Create an original creature named 苔玉小魁. It is an independent living stone golem, not a pet, animal, human, costume, or existing franchise character. A very large rounded pale warm gray jade-stone head above a short compact body; chunky short rock arms and legs with smoothly worn natural stone facets. Its recessed eyes glow a gentle clear cyan-green, with thick sculpted celadon eyebrows, an alert slightly stubborn cute expression. An ivory fabric waist sash has a fine warm-gold hem. The golem's anatomical right fist wears a substantial celadon jade bracer. Small subtle cloud carvings and moss patches support its Daoist identity, without clutter. Its stone head, feet, bracer, horn and all three leaves are clear separate readable forms.
Style: exquisite full-colour high-definition hand-painted Chinese fantasy game art, Daoist Q-version chibi proportions, plump rounded volumes, delicate controlled brushwork and clean contours, gentle painted light and shading, restrained jade and warm gold material highlights. Main palette jade green and teal, warm ivory, pale gray-beige stone and fine warm gold. It must look like finished 2D painted game art rather than a 3D render, toy, glossy plastic, vector clip-art, pixel art, or photorealism.
Camera and pose: a single full-body subject at a fixed elevated three-quarter view, facing screen bottom-right (E), neutral grounded ready stance with both stone feet visible and separated, no aggressive attack effects. Square composition, subject centered, keep at least 12 percent genuinely empty transparent margin on ALL four sides including horn, leaves and fists. Entire subject fits comfortably. Isolated transparent background with real Alpha. No floor, environment, border, card, text, letters, numbers, symbols resembling UI text, shadow puddle or watermark. No second character, no alternate poses, no diagram or turnaround sheet. No external reference image is supplied or to be copied.
